info.name: RentNest API
info.description:
RentNest rental marketplace API (Express, TypeScript, Prisma, PostgreSQL, Stripe).

1. `baseUrl` defaults to the live API (https://rentnest-backend-one.vercel.app). For local development change it to http://localhost:4000.
2. Run the three Login requests in Auth; tokens are stored automatically.
3. IDs (propertyId, categoryId, rentalId, paymentId, userId) are captured from responses.

Success: { success, message, data, meta? } · Error: { success: false, message, errorDetails }

item.name: Auth
item.description: Registration (TENANT or LANDLORD only; ADMIN cannot self-register), login and current user.

Any role. Only name, email and phone can change; role/userStatus/password are rejected (400). An email used by another account returns 409.

item.name: Get my rental request by ID

request.description:
Only for your own APPROVED rental. Open data.checkoutUrl in a browser and pay with test card 4242 4242 4242 4242 (any future date, any CVC).
Calling it again reuses an open session or replaces an expired/failed one. POST /api/payments/checkout is an alias.
Verifies the Checkout Session with Stripe. When paid: payment PAID, rental ACTIVE, property RENTED. Safe to call even if the webhook already ran.

item.name: Stripe Webhook
item.description: Called by Stripe, not by users. Requires a valid Stripe-Signature header, so a manual call returns 400.

request.description: Configure in the Stripe dashboard (events: checkout.session.completed, checkout.session.expired, checkout.session.async_payment_failed) or forward locally with `stripe listen --forward-to localhost:4000/api/payments/webhook`.
